panels.title: ⚠️ Compass Processing Health
panels.description: Critical processing signals across all six Compass job flows. Top-level health intentionally ignores job filters.

targets.expression:
fields @timestamp, @logStream, job_name, `log.level`, message
| filter @logStream like /adt-frfs-compass-${env}-${region_short}-tg-dp/
| filter `log.level` = "ALERT" or message like /Job Failure|fatal error executing job|BatchStatus: FAILED|Exception when creating ack file|Failed to write file to s3|database connection|Skip limit exceeded|ParallelLockoutListener/i
| stats count() as value

panels.title: 🎯 Affected Jobs

targets.expression:

| filter message like /Job Failure|FAILED|STOPPED|Skip limit exceeded|ParallelLockoutListener|Exception when creating ack file|Failed to write file to s3/i

## 🧭 Compass Job Dashboards & Playbooks

| Data Flow | Dashboard | Playbook |
|---|---|---|
| 🗄️ **DataLite Store Jobs** | [📊 Open Dashboard](${datalite_dashboard_url}) | [📘 Open Playbook](${datalite_playbook_url}) |
| 📥 **EASy Inbound Jobs** | [📊 Open Dashboard](${easy_dashboard_url}) | [📘 Open Playbook](${easy_playbook_url}) |
| ⚙️ **WPO Inbound Jobs** | [📊 Open Dashboard](${wpo_dashboard_url}) | [📘 Open Playbook](${wpo_playbook_url}) |
| 📊 **DataPlatform Export Jobs** | [📊 Open Dashboard](${dataplatform_dashboard_url}) | [📘 Open Playbook](${dataplatform_playbook_url}) |
| ↔️ **FLB Outbound Jobs** | [📊 Open Dashboard](${flb_dashboard_url}) | [📘 Open Playbook](${flb_playbook_url}) |
| 🔗 **SFDM Integration** | [📊 Open Dashboard](${sfdm_dashboard_url}) | [📘 Open Playbook](${sfdm_playbook_url}) |

### 🧰 Shared Operational Resources

[🖥️ Compass Infrastructure](${compass_infra_url}) •
[🗺️ Architecture](${architecture_url}) •
[📚 Runbooks / Playbooks](${runbooks_url}) •
[🔔 Alert Rules](${alert_rules_url}) •
[📞 On-Call Information](${oncall_url})

> Update the hidden URL variables after import in **Dashboard settings → Variables**.

## 🛡️ Enterprise SPOG Guardrails

**🧭 Holistic health remains global.**  
Data Flow / Job filters narrow investigative panels, but do not hide Compass-wide failures.

**🔎 Log scope**  
Application queries are constrained to the Compass ECS data-processing stream:

`adt-frfs-compass-${env}-${region_short}-tg-dp`

**🔔 Alert state**  
Current operational alert state should be authoritative from Grafana Alerting; CloudWatch logs provide diagnostic context.

**⏱️ Freshness**  
This version shows **Last Success** only. Add true *Expected By / Overdue / Jobs OK x/y* after the six production schedules and grace windows are confirmed.

**⚪ Unknown ≠ Healthy**  
No-data, query errors, or missing expected telemetry should surface as UNKNOWN / needs investigation.

**🟢 HEALTHY** — expected processing normal  
**🟡 DEGRADED / ATTENTION** — warning, retry, stale/overdue, elevated backlog  
**🔴 CRITICAL** — failed/stopped processing, critical alert, DLQ, or blocking condition  
**⚪ UNKNOWN** — missing telemetry / no-data where data is expected
